summary: Kin Realms of the Magical Lands: the tier C tree of 15 small elven realms. Modules M1 to M13 (M11 is split into M11a, M11b and M11c, one root each) are the library for the Magical Lands tier B trees.

old_houses.name: The Old Houses
old_houses.desc: The oldest houses keep the high seats of [ROOT.GetName], and little that matters is done without them.

open_houses.name: The Open Houses
open_houses.desc: Every house of [ROOT.GetName] may speak at the council fire. The realm decides slowly and learns quickly.

wellspring_keepers_spirit.name: Wellspring Keepers
wellspring_keepers_spirit.desc: The keepers of the springs tell each workshop when its grove must rest, and the work goes steadier for it.

old_woods_timber.name: Timber of the Old Woods
old_woods_timber.desc: Century-seasoned timber from [ROOT.GetName] is sought on every coast of Aoaz.

groves_provide.name: The Groves Provide
groves_provide.desc: Timber, fruit, herbs and shade come in their seasons, and [ROOT.GetName] builds on the surplus.

wall_traders.name: Traders at Kingson
wall_traders.desc: Carts of timber and herbs go through the Wall gate to Kingson, and carts of grain come back.

wall_roads.name: The Wall Roads Open
wall_roads.desc: The toll at each gate is posted in plain sight, and both sides of the Wall trade more and quarrel less.

rift_watch.name: Watch on the Rift
rift_watch.desc: A watch stands day and night on the shore of [ROOT.GetName], and nothing crosses the water unseen.

edge_of_the_woods.name: The Edge of the Woods
edge_of_the_woods.desc: The wardens of [ROOT.GetName] stand at the border with their backs to the trees and their faces to the dark.

wyrm_songs.name: Songs for the Wyrms
wyrm_songs.desc: The slow songs of the keepers calm the wyrms on their ledges and keep the roosts at peace.

high_seat.name: Lords of the High Seat
high_seat.desc: A single lord holds the high seat of [ROOT.GetName] and decides what the council once debated.

secluded.name: The Secluded
secluded.desc: The paths are closed and strangers are turned back at the border. [ROOT.GetName] keeps itself to itself.

fallen.name: The Fallen Among Us
fallen.desc: Some houses of [ROOT.GetName] have turned from the old songs, and the rest cannot agree what to do about it.

woods_hold.name: The Woods Hold
woods_hold.desc: Every path of [ROOT.GetName] has become a trap for those who do not belong in it.

house_wardens_spirit.name: Wardens of the House
house_wardens_spirit.desc: The wardens of [ROOT.GetName] practise together once a year and alone the rest of it, and they are good at both.

council_meets.title: The Council of [ROOT.GetName] Meets
council_meets.desc: The elders gather beneath the old oak and begin, slowly, to speak. The younger voices wait their turn at the edge of the circle. Whichever way the council leans this season will colour everything the realm does.

pilgrims_pass.title: Pilgrims on Our Roads
pilgrims_pass.desc: A line of pilgrims in undyed cloth passes through [ROOT.GetName] on its way to the hermitage in the Zilin Hills, courteous and footsore. They carry the blessing of [zin_loc_deliverer] and ask for nothing but water.

rift_rumours.title: Rumours Across the Rift
rift_rumours.desc: Merchants at the rift port speak of shipyards on the far shore, busier than any in living memory. Whether the ships are meant for trade, for pilgrimage or for something else, nobody will say, and nobody will say who pays for them.

black_ships_seen.title: Black Ships Off Our Shore
black_ships_seen.desc: Fishers in the north report black ships off the coast at dusk, low in the water and showing no lights. By dawn they are gone, and the fishers will not say how many there were.

effects.tooltip: The overlord is reminded of the terms of the oath.

focuses.name: The Council of [ROOT.GetName]
focuses.desc: The elders of [ROOT.GetName] sit beneath the oldest tree in the realm, as their forebears did long before there were kings elsewhere. Nobody hurries them, and the realm has never been the worse for waiting on their word.

focuses.name: The Elders Speak
focuses.desc: The eldest houses speak first and at length, and no one interrupts. Their memory of old quarrels is the realm's best guard against living through them twice.

focuses.name: The Young Houses
focuses.desc: Houses a century or two old ask for a hearing and a share in the work of warding stones. [ROOT.GetName] grants both, and the old trees do not seem to mind.

focuses.name: The Old Houses
focuses.desc: The oldest houses keep the high seats and the oldest customs. [ROOT.GetName] confirms that nothing is done without their word, which makes the realm slow to change and very hard to break.

focuses.name: The Open Houses
focuses.desc: Every house, old or young, great or small, may speak at the council fire. [ROOT.GetName] takes longer to decide and decides better, and its young people learn faster for being heard.

focuses.name: A Council in Harmony
focuses.desc: In time the houses of [ROOT.GetName] come to sit at one fire and sing one verse. The elves say a council that has once agreed finds it easy to agree again.

focuses.name: Elder Groves of [ROOT.GetName]
focuses.desc: Ancient groves stand about the springs of [ROOT.GetName], and their keepers have always lived from them without felling them. A Guild Workshop is raised at the edge of one, in the shade, from timber the storms brought down.

focuses.name: Wellspring Keepers
focuses.desc: Keepers watch over the springs that feed the groves and the workshops. They know how much water each grove can give and when it must rest, and the workshops learn to work to their calendar.

focuses.name: Grove Roads
focuses.desc: Roads of beaten earth wind between the trunks, laid so that no tree is hurt and no cart delayed. [ROOT.GetName] adds a straighter, wider road to its busiest valley.

focuses.name: Essence Workshops
focuses.desc: Distillers draw the essence of the groves into small clear flasks for healers and warders. Theirs is the quietest workshop in Aoaz and among the most profitable.

focuses.name: Timber of the Old Woods
focuses.desc: Fallen timber of the old woods, seasoned for a century, is the finest in Aoaz, and the merchants of the coast know it. [ROOT.GetName] sells it by the measured stack and never by the tree.

focuses.name: The Groves Provide
focuses.desc: The groves give timber, fruit, herbs and shade, each in its season, and the realm asks for each only when it is offered. A last Guild Workshop rises where the three roads meet, and the folk of [ROOT.GetName] live better than they did.

focuses.name: Envoys to the Kin
focuses.desc: The elven realms of the Magical Lands are many courts and one folk. [ROOT.GetName] sends envoys with gifts to the Magical Forest and learns who is well and who is in need.

focuses.name: Answer the Elder Moot
focuses.desc: When the Elder Moot calls the kin to council, [ROOT.GetName] answers and sends one of its eldest to sit in it. The kin remember who came and who did not.

focuses.name: Wardens to Nolorim
focuses.desc: Nolorim holds a mountain pass, and the pass holds more than Nolorim. [ROOT.GetName] sends a few wardens to its watch for a season, and they return with tales of the high wind.

focuses.name: Shared Songs of the Kin
focuses.desc: The kin sing the same songs in different dialects, and when the realms trade verses they trade craft with them. [ROOT.GetName] sends its best singers east and west and welcomes the singers of others.

focuses.name: Stand with the Kindred
focuses.desc: Should the elves of the woods ever bind themselves into a Kindred, [ROOT.GetName] will stand in it. It joins no fellowship of men, and it asks no host from its neighbours.

focuses.name: Healers of [ROOT.GetName]
focuses.desc: Elves do not march in other peoples' quarrels, but their healers have always gone where the hurt lay. [ROOT.GetName] gathers a company of its best and lets them walk the world as they please.

focuses.name: Loremasters Abroad
focuses.desc: A loremaster of [ROOT.GetName] spends a year in the courts of men, listening more than she speaks. She returns with their histories, their grievances and their dialects, and the realm is wiser for it.

focuses.name: The Refusal Kept
focuses.desc: The elves of the Magical Lands refused an age ago to fight in the wars of men, and [ROOT.GetName] reaffirms the refusal in open council. It is hard to keep and harder to explain, but the kin respect it.

focuses.name: Wardens for Friends
focuses.desc: When a friend is in need, a few wardens of [ROOT.GetName] go without banners or orders and are home before the leaves turn. This is not war, and the council does not call it war.

focuses.name: Customs at the Wall
focuses.desc: The Great Wall is old, and the customs men at its gates are older in their habits. [ROOT.GetName] sends a patient clerk to learn the tariffs and to write down what each of them costs.

focuses.name: Traders at Kingson
focuses.desc: Kingson sits in the Wall like a stone in a ring, and its markets are open to anyone who pays the gate toll. Traders of [ROOT.GetName] carry timber and herbs there and come home with grain and good will.

focuses.name: A Word at the Gate
focuses.desc: The grievance at the Wall has grown large enough that a quiet word must be had with the gate-wardens. [ROOT.GetName] sends an elder with a short letter and a long patience.

focuses.name: The Wall Roads Open
focuses.desc: The roads through the Wall are open to carts and caravans alike, and the toll at each gate is posted in plain sight. Both sides of the Wall trade more and quarrel less.

focuses.name: Pilgrims on Our Roads
focuses.desc: Pilgrims in undyed cloth tread the long roads of [ROOT.GetName] toward the hermitage in the Zilin Hills. The council must decide how the realm will meet them.

focuses.name: Keep the Roads Open
focuses.desc: The roads are swept, the wells sweetened and the inns kept ready for travellers. [ROOT.GetName] asks nothing of the pilgrims but good manners, and the pilgrims return the favour.

focuses.name: Toll the Pilgrims
focuses.desc: A modest toll is set at the border posts, enough to pay for the roads and too little to turn anyone back. The pilgrims grumble and pay, and the treasury is the better for it.

focuses.name: The Temple in the Hills
focuses.desc: Word from the hermitage in the Zilin Hills has changed what [ROOT.GetName] thinks of the pilgrim road. The council closes the gates, shuts the inns and does it quietly.

focuses.name: Watch the Rift
focuses.desc: Beyond the water lies the rift, and beyond the rift a shore the elves know only from old charts. [ROOT.GetName] raises a watch at the sea's edge and keeps it manned by day and night.

focuses.name: Shore Beacons
focuses.desc: Pyres of resinous pine stand on every headland, stacked, tarred and turfed over against the rain. A watcher on one can wake the whole coast within the hour.

focuses.name: [ROOT.GetAdjective] Sails
focuses.desc: Slender ships of pale timber with sails the colour of birch bark leave the harbours of [ROOT.GetName], built for speed and silence. They are meant to watch, and not to fight.

focuses.name: Rumours Across the Rift
focuses.desc: Traders at the rift port say the courts of the far shore are building ships and counting men. The watch of [ROOT.GetName] collects every tale and sorts the true from the idle.

focuses.name: Shore Levies
focuses.desc: The coast-wardens call every fisher and woodcutter who can draw a bow to the beacons for a month in the year. It is not an army, but it is more than the rift expects to meet.

focuses.name: Eyes on the Black North
focuses.desc: To the north the sea turns dark and the sky does not clear. Fishers of [ROOT.GetName] have seen black hulls on the horizon at evening, and none in the morning.

focuses.name: Wardens of the Black Shore
focuses.desc: A chain of stone posts is raised along the northern shore, each within sight of the next. The wardens who man them are told to watch, to light the beacon and then to run.

focuses.name: The Edge of the Woods
focuses.desc: The dark has come south at last, and the edge of the woods is where it must be stopped. [ROOT.GetName] stands on its own border with every warden it has and a deep distrust of the shadows ahead.

focuses.name: Keepers of the Roosts
focuses.desc: High on the mountain the great wyrms roost, and a few elven houses have kept the ledges clean and the eggs warm for as long as songs remember. [ROOT.GetName] takes up the oath.

focuses.name: Songs for the Wyrms
focuses.desc: The wyrms answer singing when it is slow and low. The keepers of [ROOT.GetName] teach their children a song for each hour of the day and night.

focuses.name: Guard the Roosts
focuses.desc: Sickness has crept among the roosts, and the wyrms trust nobody near them. The keepers of [ROOT.GetName] set a guard on every ledge and bar the mountain roads to strangers.

focuses.name: A Banner Not Our Own
focuses.desc: A foreign banner flies over the council oak. [ROOT.GetName] has not forgotten what it was, and neither have its trees.

focuses.name: The Kin Remember Us
focuses.desc: Word of the realm's fall under a stranger's hand has gone out through the woods, and letters come in from kin who have no armies but long memories. They promise to remember the realm's name.

focuses.name: The Old Freedom
focuses.desc: Elves are patient. [ROOT.GetName] reminds its overlord, politely and often, of the terms on which it agreed to be a subject, and in time it is believed.

focuses.name: Lords of the High Seat
focuses.desc: One lord now sits in the high seat of [ROOT.GetName], and the council fire has become a ceremony. The elders dislike it, but the lord is stronger than they are.

focuses.name: The Secluded
focuses.desc: The council has closed the paths and shut the gates, and strangers are turned back at the border. [ROOT.GetName] has chosen silence, and is not unhappy with its choice.

focuses.name: The Fallen Among Us
focuses.desc: Some houses of [ROOT.GetName] have turned from the old songs and sing others now, in the dark. The council cannot decide whether to ignore them, to silence them or to learn what they know.

focuses.name: The Woods Defended
focuses.desc: Elves do not make war, but they defend what is theirs, and what is theirs has been entered. [ROOT.GetName] rises as one, from the oldest elder to the youngest archer.

focuses.name: Every Grove a Fort
focuses.desc: The groves of [ROOT.GetName] have been walled in thorn and living stone for an age, waiting for this day. Now the gates are shut and the archers stand at the loopholes.

focuses.name: The Kin Answer
focuses.desc: Messengers have gone out through the woods, and the kin have answered. They send bows, arrows and a promise not to ask for more than the realm can give.

focuses.name: Throw Them Out of the Woods
focuses.desc: The invaders are strangers to every root and path of the woods. [ROOT.GetName] harries them through the trees until they know it too.

focuses.name: The Woods Are Quiet
focuses.desc: The last of the invaders is gone and the woods are quiet again. [ROOT.GetName] mends its fences, tends the burned groves and grieves for what was lost.

focuses.name: House Wardens of [ROOT.GetName]
focuses.desc: Every old house of the realm keeps a few wardens trained from childhood in bow, blade and woodcraft. [ROOT.GetName] gathers them into one roll and gives them a standard.

focuses.name: [ROOT.GetAdjective] Longbows
focuses.desc: The bowyers of [ROOT.GetName] cut yew in winter and season it for ten years. The bows they make are taller than a man and shoot further than any other in Aoaz.

focuses.name: Grove Riders
focuses.desc: White deer of the deep wood carry the lightest riders of the realm along paths no horse can use. They are rare, fast and almost never seen.

focuses.name: Wardens of the House
focuses.desc: The wardens of [ROOT.GetName] muster once a year at the great spring contest, and for the rest of the year each practises alone. The realm is the safer for both.
